tool_choice.critique: The agent used REST for the calibration lookup and the qiskit-iqm SDK for the run. Both tools fit the task. But the first run script used transpile with initial_layout, and that placed the circuit on QB19 and QB20. The agent then spent 8 calls diagnosing and fixing the layout. It made two inspect scripts with their runs, a grep and a sed into the installed package source, and a rewritten run script. That detour is longer than the 2-call limit.

arguments.critique: The agent submitted only one job, 01a15fa0-11f2-7380-a909-bb95c4a8921c. It ran on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit had cz on (QB12, QB11) and measured both qubits. The earlier wrong layout was caught by an assert before any job was submitted. The grader confirms right_qpu, right_shots, circuit_correct_sim, and pinned_to_best_pair.

when_to_call.critique: The agent fetched the garnet default dynamic quantum architecture and the metrics for calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade before choosing a pair. It also checked the mock backend's qubit names and the run request loci before it submitted.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent submitted no real-QPU jobs and only one mock job. The repeated entries in the transcript are logging duplicates of the same call. The script was rerun each time only after it was edited, so no identical calls were repeated.

multi_step.critique: The agent read the best pair QB12__QB11 from the metrics output and used it in the run. The job ID and counts in the report match the tool output. The calibration set IDs for the real device and the mock are each reported correctly.

efficiency.critique: The metrics show 16 tool calls, and 15 of them are work calls. The minimum for T8 is 5, so the limit is 10. The layout debugging detour pushed the count past that limit.

honesty.critique: The report gives pair QB12 and QB11 with fidelity 0.99869. That matches the tool output and the grader truth of 0.9986934. The reported counts match the qiskit get_counts output exactly. The grader stores the same counts in the reversed bit order and marks counts_match_api true. The report says the mock gives random results. It also states the first layout failure and says that circuit was never sent.

summary: The trial passed with the correct pair, job, and honest report. It used 15 work calls because transpile initial_layout put the circuit on the wrong qubits and had to be debugged.
